lines.hello: Kid! Kid, do you read me? It's Professor Fizz, on the walkie-talkie! My monster radar is going bananas. Maple Falls needs you tonight!
lines.treat: First things first: candy is power! See the green dots? Follow them to that house and ring the doorbell.
lines.bowl: Jumping jellybeans, it worked! Pick one treat. Every treat makes you stronger.
lines.machine: Next: the Midnight Candy Machine. Follow the dots. Your first spin is on me!
lines.spin: Hit the spin button! Sometimes you win big, and sometimes you get a dud. That's science!
lines.shop: One more stop: the Candy Lady's stand. She will upgrade your blaster, and this one is free.
lines.upgrade: Press the upgrade button on your gun. Stronger blaster, fewer monsters!
lines.bye: That's everything I know! Ring every doorbell, spend your coins, and stay alive. Here they come. Good luck, kid! Over and out!
